rationale: This change adds a root-scoped View mutation/lifetime gate (DispatchLease plus View::retire) so an imported UI's JavaScript handler cannot destroy the View whose callback is executing, and makes frame-clock propagation exactly-once per walk. It reaches four watched families only through their path selectors, and changes nothing any of them is about. render-assets-and-backends carries the bulk via the core/view/** selector: every file there is View ownership, identity and callback sequencing. No render backend, raster path, GPU surface, asset pipeline, or Skia/Dawn code is touched. design-source-ingest and design-output-and-packaging are crossed by exactly one file, tools/import-design/jsx-runtime/materialized_runtime_entry.mjs, whose materialized-owner heuristic arrived with the retained-reparent commits this branch replays and is unrelated to the lifetime gate; no importer, DesignIR schema, codegen output, or packaging artifact changes. visual-proof-harness is crossed by exactly one file, test/cmake/view_widget_bridge_tests.cmake, only to register two new Catch2 suites; no fixture, baseline, screenshot, or harness contract changes. Registered as watch-only so the families' coverage stays honest about a lifetime change that crossed their selectors. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
